theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.OpenMathCore.addPotential_apply
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (A B : RealPotential) (x : BitString) : (addPotential A B).value x = A.value x + B.value x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.OpenMathCore.addPotential_assoc
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (A B C : RealPotential) : ∀ x, (addPotential (addPotential A B) C).value x = (addPotential A (addPotential B C)).value x

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (x y : BitString) : arithmeticMass (x ++ y) = arithmeticMass x + arithmeticMass y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.OpenMathCore.bitLength_append
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (x y : BitString) : bitLength (x ++ y) = bitLength x + bitLength y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.OpenMathCore.bitWeight_append
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (x y : BitString) : bitWeight (x ++ y) = bitWeight x + bitWeight y

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.OpenMathCore.bitWeight_cons
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (b : Bool) (xs : BitString) : bitWeight (b :: xs) = bitNat b + bitWeight xs

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.OpenMathCore.mismatch_exact

theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (M : PolyDTMCandidate) (x : BitString) : CandidateMismatch M x ↔ ¬ DeclaredSATMatch M x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.OpenMathCore.scalePotential_apply
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (c : ℝ) (A : RealPotential) (x : BitString) : (scalePotential c A).value x = c * A.value x

theorems_only_on_branches.name: MCore.Real.OpenMathCore.scale_addPotential
theorems_only_on_branches.statement: (c : ℝ) (A B : RealPotential) : ∀ x, (scalePotential c (addPotential A B)).value x = (addPotential (scalePotential c A) (scalePotential c B)).value x
